capabilities: Import Zotero metadata, collections and local PDF attachments
Convert PDFs to Markdown with OCR, keeping equations, tables and figures
Translate papers and compare original and translation side by side
Copy citations in APA, IEEE, GB/T 7714, MLA or export BibTeX, RIS, CSL-JSON
Generate optional structured summaries as separate notes
extras: Desktop only. PDF conversion, translation and summaries are processed by the Recto cloud service (api.rectoai.uk); conversion is currently free while translation uses purchased page credits that do not expire. DOI, arXiv and title lookups go directly from the device to OpenAlex, Unpaywall, Crossref, Semantic Scholar and arXiv.
motivation: The author notes that researchers keep hundreds of papers in Zotero but read only a fraction closely, because reading means switching between a PDF reader and a translation tool.
problem: Papers sit in Zotero while reading happens in a separate PDF viewer and translation tool, so useful passages never become searchable notes.

relations.evidence: Import bibliographic metadata and locally available PDF attachments together, preserving Zotero's collection hierarchy
The detail panel flags missing fields such as volume or pages and can complete them from Crossref.

summary: Imports a Zotero paper library into Obsidian, converts PDFs to Markdown with OCR, and translates papers for side-by-side reading.
